content.comment_body: I've encountered problems installing an update on macOS. After unzipping the file and navigating the folders, I find an app named 'set up.' When I try to launch it, an error appears stating the application can't be opened, as shown in the screenshot. Even after viewing the contents of the 'set up' file and exploring related macOS files, the problem persists. Any assistance would be appreciated, since I'm unable to use my new [company_name] [product_name] as a result.
Which macOS version are you using? [product_name] [version_no] hasn't been tested with all macOS versions, so there might be a compatibility issue.

analysis.insight_summary: The user faces installation issues when trying to update [product_name] from [version_no] to another release on macOS. The installation app fails to launch, preventing use of recently acquired [company_name] hardware. There are compatibility concerns for the software with certain macOS releases, leading to user uncertainty regarding installation support.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a straightforward installation process for the latest [product_name] on macOS and reliable compatibility with newly purchased [company_name] hardware.
